cost: No live installation or surprise Azure action
summary: A developer coding demo with exact source prompts and safe fallback. The 15 minutes excludes laptop provisioning, approvals, package/image restoration and cloud delivery.

purpose.p: Show a small financial behavior change, truthful checks, a human-run prepared sample and a protected existing-AKS design.
Do not claim timed laptop setup, recorded output as live proof, completed modernization or cloud deployment. Stop when prerequisites fail.

ul: Approved setup/profile/source acceptance, explicit Dependencies Restore, daily checks and rehearsal completed separately by the human.
If using containers, existing images from previously confirmed Restore ContainerImages and an approved healthy runtime.
Safe reviewed main checkout and separately inspected demo-complete schedule fallback. Historical unsafe demo-baseline is never run/reset/deployed.
Required GitHub/Copilot access and optional Java 11/modernization prerequisites arranged beforehand; no live installation/repair.

steps.title: 00:00-02:00: readiness and developer workflow
steps.where: VS Code › Terminal / Testing / Workstation onboarding

body.p: Say: prerequisites come before scripts; installed-first modules retain existing software. Optional pre-setup inventory gaps are not post-setup acceptance. Human Restore is separate; daily checks never install.

steps.expect: Accurate observed readiness/checks or clearly dated/revision-labelled fallback; no laptop repair.

steps.title: 02:00-06:00: scoped EMI schedule and focused tests

body.p: Review focused changes and use existing-environment Test Python/Coverage Python tasks. Preserve rounded EMI and existing /emi total_payment; apply one-time prepayment after the selected regular installment, shorten tenure, settle final principal plus rounded interest exactly.
If unfinished or prerequisites unavailable, inspect the retained demo-complete schedule and labelled evidence; do not accept an unfinished diff to meet the clock.

steps.expect: Scoped implementation/tests with invalid/rounding/settlement coverage, or explicit unfinished/NOT RUN.

steps.title: 06:00-08:00: operator launch and synthetic request
steps.where: Terminal › Run EMI API (container) › Second terminal

body.p: Human operates the existing approved image/runtime. Auto considers Docker only when wslc is absent, never after failure/denial. Missing runtime/image means no launch; show labelled evidence instead.

steps.expect: Actual health and exact synthetic response, not a live agent launch or hidden image acquisition.

steps.title: 08:00-10:30: existing-AKS preparation, not deployment

body.p: Show current-main manual dispatch, modern CI, separate identities, same-run immutable digests and independently verified aks-demo protection. Human may choose a static manifest check with existing dependencies only; do not dispatch in this segment.

steps.expect: Files-only review with real missing inputs and live-evidence gaps; no Azure resource or authentication action.

steps.title: 10:30-13:00: review the isolated non-serving fixture

body.p: Identify fixture line references for raw query-string logging and internal-error disclosure; contrast safe serving Go regression tests. The human can run Lint Go/Test Go/Coverage Go using existing Go; never copy defects into a service/image.

steps.expect: Concrete training findings and truthful checks, no serving-code exceptions or restored unsafe baseline.

steps.title: 13:00-15:00: authorized GitHub review and optional assessment
steps.where: Source Control › GitHub Pull Requests view

body.p: Only explicitly authorized stage/commit/Publish Branch/PR actions; preserve template and exact observed checks/skips. Main review and deployment approval remain separate.

If already rehearsed, assess the intentional Java 11/Boot 2.7 legacy sample with modernization tooling. A short assessment is not a completed migration; do not upgrade it by hand, include it in default CI or deploy it.

steps.expect: A reviewable truthful handoff, not a promise that cloud setup or modernization finished in 15 minutes.

expected.p: A rehearsed developer presentation with exact synthetic contracts, scoped diff, observed or clearly labelled fallback evidence and no surprise state-changing agent action.

success.p: Keep timing and setup windows distinct. Show source/runtime/date for evidence and confirm every real action was explicitly human-operated; do not turn a demo checklist into a machine-success claim.

failures.symptom: Prerequisite or coding task is unfinished during the presentation
failures.fix: Stop the live claim and show inspected safe fallback/labelled recorded evidence. No repair, install or unfinished merge to meet the clock.

failures.symptom: Only historical unsafe demo-baseline is available
failures.fix: Do not run/reset/deploy it. Use a separately prepared reviewed main or inspected demo-complete schedule source.

failures.symptom: Requested cloud action exceeds files-only segment
failures.fix: Keep the demo static; separate any human cloud request into the protected optional delivery path.

recovery.p: Preserve all unrelated source/unsaved work, stop only owned tasks, and use [safe recovery](page:operate-recovery). Never reset a dirty/shared checkout or sweep containers.

limitations.p: The companion did not rehearse this laptop's 15-minute live presentation; static pages and old CI do not prove timing or success.

say: The presentation starts after separate setup, Restore and rehearsal.
Exact financial invariants remain visible, and unfinished work stays unfinished.
Fallback evidence is dated and scoped; no surprise deployment or unsafe baseline.
evidence_gaps: No successful live laptop rehearsal, sample/container request, modernization or cloud segment is recorded by this companion.
